definitions.explanation: The department or division within a company responsible for sales and business development.

examples.japanese: {営業部|えいぎょうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配属|はいぞく}→配属：06159_haizoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was assigned to the sales department.

examples.japanese: {営業部|えいぎょうぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The sales department meeting is every Monday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{営業部|えいぎょうぶ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{企画部|きかくぶ}→企画部：27613_kikakubu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧になった。
examples.english: He was transferred from the sales department to the planning department.

notes:
The department within a company responsible for sales activities and business development. In Japanese companies, {営業部|えいぎょうぶ} staff typically handle client relations, sales targets, and revenue generation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧ (sales; business) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (department; division)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {営業部|えいぎょうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配属|はいぞく}→配属：06159_haizoku⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ — to be assigned to the sales department
- {営業部|えいぎょうぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧ — sales department manager
- {営業部|えいぎょうぶ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to transfer from the sales department

OTHER COMMON DEPARTMENTS:
- ⟦{企画部|きかくぶ}→企画部：27613_kikakubu⟧ — planning department
- ⟦{総務部|そうむぶ}→総務部：23789_soumubu⟧ — general affairs department
- ⟦{人事部|じんじぶ}→人事部：20638_jinjibu⟧ — human resources department
- {経理部|けいりぶ} — accounting department
